newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: GP Batteries gets Sing dollar listing.
newsitem.headline: GP Batteries gets Sing dollar listing.

text.p: GP Batteries International Ltd said on Thursday the listing and trading of its shares will be converted to Singapore dollars from U.S. dollars with effect from May 27, 1997.
A company statement said listing and trading of its warrants which are due November 15, 2000 will also be converted to Singapore dollars.
It said the conversion of the trading currency of the warrants would not result in any changes to the principal terms of the warrants.
The exercise price of the warrants will remain unchanged at US$2.10 per warrant.
